Witness types for Bulla.

Command probes are exec'd directly, not through a shell: day splits on
whitespace and runs the argv, so `$(...)`, globs and redirections never expand.
A probe using them fails with a `test` usage error rather than a useful answer.
Probes below are therefore shell-metacharacter-free.

boot-evidence names the reboot log specifically, since test-qemu.py writes it
last. Its presence evidences that the whole matrix completed, which is a better
witness than "some evidence exists".

```day-witness
{
  "upstream-pin": {"path": "docs/upstream-pin.md"},
  "reproduction-record": {"path": "docs/reproduction.md"},
  "run-doc": {"path": "docs/running.md"},
  "status-table": {"path": "docs/roadmap.md"},
  "verified-source": {"path": "src/*.th"},
  "trusted-base-inventory": {"path": "platform/x86_64-pc-uefi-smp-v1/registry.toml"},
  "bootable-image": {"command": "test -s dist/bulla.img"},
  "build-receipt": {"command": "test -s dist/bulla.receipt.json"},
  "boot-evidence": {"command": "test -s dist/boot-evidence/boot-2-reboot.log"},
  "published-artifact": {"tag": "v*"}
}
```
